rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when information, meaning, or a definition is not clear.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 se2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when a statement or wording is ambiguous and allows more than one interpretation.

example.english: What they said was unclear, so I don't know what they meant.
example.traditional: 佢講得含糊，我唔知佢想點。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dak1 ham4 wu4 ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is personally uncertain or does not know exactly what something means.

example.english: I'm unclear about what this character means.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 ni1 go3 zi6 dim2 gaai2

rows.note: Use this for writing, images, or other visual details that are blurry or difficult to make out.

example.english: The photo is too unclear to make out people's faces.
example.traditional: 張相太模糊，睇唔到人樣。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng2 taai3 mou4 wu4 tai2 m4 dou2 jan4 joeng6
